_extraction_flags.notes: Excellent O-ISAC paper! Novel PC-FMCW joint waveform. Phase coding for comm, squaring removes it for sensing.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: PC-FMCW system schematic with sensing (coherent detection + squaring) and communication (self-delayed coherent detection) paths. Fig.2: OptiSystem simulation layout. Fig.3: Results showing decoded bits and ranging spectra at 10/20/30m.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Phase-Coded FMCW (PC-FMCW) LiDAR with communication. Sensing uses coherent detection + signal squaring to eliminate phase code influence. Communication uses self-delayed coherent detection (DPSK principle). Joint waveform: phase shifts (0, π) carry comm data on FMCW.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 1 Gbps, phase shifts 0/π. Sensing: B=10 GHz sweep, T=10 µs period. Range: 10/20/30 m verified. Beat frequencies: 266.7/533.3/800 MHz. Velocity measurement possible via Doppler. OptiSystem 15 simulation.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Novel PC-FMCW joint waveform with elegant squaring technique to decouple sensing from comm. Better BER than AM-FMCW. Turbulence robust via self-delayed coherent detection. Gap: Simulation only, no experimental validation.

bibliographic.title: Phase-Coded FMCW for Optical Integrated Sensing and Communication
bibliographic.authors: Tianzhu Zhang, Zhongji Yan, Anning Pang, Anhong Dang

application.scenario_description: Coherent LiDAR with communication capability for vehicular networks and remote sensing.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Phase-Coded FMCW joint waveform where signal squaring at sensing receiver eliminates communication code influence, enabling interference-free dual functionality.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: AM-FMCW has lower BER performance and is susceptible to turbulence-induced phase drift.

transmitter.notes: CW laser at 193 THz (1550 nm), 30 dBm. PM for phase coding. Sweep BW = 10 GHz, period = 10 µs.

receiver.notes: Sensing: BPD + squaring + FFT. Communication: Self-delayed coherent detection (DPSK receiver).

integration.notes: Single TX waveform, separate processing for sensing (transceiver) and communication (target).

waveform.notes: PC-FMCW: Phase shifts (0, π) carry comm data on FMCW chirp. Squaring removes phase code for sensing.

channel_wireless.notes: Round-trip delay τ = 2R/c. Beat frequencies: 266.7 MHz (10m), 533.3 MHz (20m), 800 MHz (30m).

comm_metrics.notes: 1 Gbps code rate. BPSK-like phase coding (0, π). Differential encoding for flipping correction.

sensing_metrics.notes: Range resolution = c/(2B) = 1.5 cm for 10 GHz sweep. Velocity via Doppler from up/down ramps.

tradeoff.notes: No mutual interference when phase shifts are 0 and π. Squaring completely eliminates communication code from sensing signal.
